segments.he: אוֹ שֶׁנַּעֲשֵׂית אַנְגַּרְיָא, אוֹמֵר לוֹ: הֲרֵי שֶׁלְּךָ לְפָנֶיךָ. אָמַר רַב: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא בְּאַנְגַּרְיָא חוֹזֶרֶת. אֲבָל אַנְגַּרְיָא שֶׁאֵינָהּ חוֹזֶרֶת, חַיָּיב לְהַעֲמִיד לוֹ חֲמוֹר.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «Or» if the donkey «was seized for public service,» the owner can «say to» the renter: «That which is yours is before you. Rav says: They taught» this halakha «only with regard to temporary public service,» i.e., the government confiscates the animal for a certain period of time, after which they return it. «But» in a case of «permanent public service,» where they confiscated the animal permanently, the owner is «obligated to provide» the renter with another «donkey.»
